text:
Predicates:
InternationalStudent(x) ::: x is an international student.
US(x) ::: x is in the US.
F1(x) ::: x has an F1 visa.
J1(x) ::: x has a J1 visa.
WantsToWork(x) ::: x wants to work in the US.
ApplyCPT(x) ::: x applies for CPT.
ApplyOPT(x) ::: x applies for OPT.
NeedsToApply(x) ::: x needs to apply for CPT or OPT.
Mike ::: Mike.

Premises:
(InternationalStudent(x) ∧ US(x)) → (F1(x) ∨ J1(x)) ::: International students in US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
(InternationalStudent(x) ∧ US(x) ∧ F1(x) ∧ WantsToWork(x)) → (ApplyCPT(x) ∨ ApplyOPT(x)) ::: An international student in US with an F1 visa needs to apply for CPT or OPT if they want to work in the US.
Mike ::: Mike.
(InternationalStudent(Mike) ∧ US(Mike)) → NeedsToApply(Mike) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work in the US.

Conclusion:
NeedsToApply(Mike) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT or OPT.
